analysis: The supplied units are base-side excerpts (lines 930-1839) of docs/developer/test.md. The file changes are documentation only: a date bump, CI sharding and build-once wording, a warning for unweighted serial suites, and relocated line ranges. The visible patch excerpt is truncated, so some later changes are not visible. I found no code, key handling, authorization, attestation, encryption, cache or wire-protocol change. The examined text describes test procedures that touch several threat boundaries: App Attest resumption and logout (TB-011, T-053, A-008), the add-on hold socket (TB-012, T-059/T-060), native serving qualification, SDK 27.2 Date comparison checks, and the cluster tests. The text states that the tests use loopback and isolated temp roots, that they never stop an operator process, and that they do not establish physical Apple qualification. No security claim in it is weakened, and nothing re-scopes T-041 or the prefix cache controls. Limits: the head side of the large changed ranges (for example the head-side 1214-1227 region) was not supplied, so wording changes there are unexamined. Whether the CI sharding and build-once changes in workflows or scripts affect gating, such as the qualify-sdk audit of executed counts or the Provider Tests gate, cannot be judged from this file. The new warn-instead-of-fail behavior for unweighted serial suites in the last shard's audit is described only as a documentation change. Any script change behind it belongs to other units and is not shown here.
